The rabbits at the pet shop are sick!! With parasites that are only transmitted between rabbits. The vet told us they've already had several cases of young bunnies like this. THEY CAN'T BE MORE IRRESPONSIBLE. My rabbit is hospitalized in very serious condition, €500 in tests and emergency care, and we don't know if we can save him. All the other rabbits there must be infected.

UPDATE: He died. The infection from those parasites was so severe that he couldn't survive despite all the vets' efforts.

After she'd just sold it to me, I asked for the manager, and she said she didn't know because she was sick.
